content: Standard lead-inbox pattern for inbound web-form submissions: each submission becomes a tracked record with a status field (New -> Contacted -> Converted/Qualified, or similar small enum), not a raw shared-inbox email dump (which loses ownership/accountability). Lightweight implementations route all new leads into a single review queue where staff triage/tag before deeper follow-up. Non-negotiables cited across sources: capture with full form context, visible status, and some notification/visibility so leads don't go stale -- NOT full pipeline/deal-stage CRM machinery (multi-stage sales pipelines, deal values, forecasting) which is overkill for a first version with only two form sources (Contacts, Demo).
